title: Decentralized Multi-Agent System: A Blackboard-Based Peer Review Architecture for LLM Agents
description: A research prototype for decentralized coordination among LLM agents using a SQLite blackboard, proposal voting, and artifact peer review. This release is a technical-report / working-paper package intended for reproducible inspection, not a peer-reviewed paper.
notes: The archive records a research prototype and working-paper materials. Claims are limited to implementation-grounded observations unless controlled experiments are explicitly reported.
